channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Jerwood Foundation: Arts Grants (2027 round)
    https://jerwood.org/funding/
    Jerwood Foundation · deadline 17 Mar 2027 · No published minimum or maximum. Previous awards have reached up to GBP 200,000, but most grants are considerably smaller. Funds project and activity costs. No formal match-funding requirement, but a fundraising strategy must be submitted. No application fee.
  • Creative Scotland: National Lottery Open Fund for Organisations (rolling)
    https://www.creativescotland.com/funding/funding-programmes/open-funding/national-lottery-open-fund-for-organisations
    Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 1,000 to 100,000. Covers a one-off project or production, creative research and development, a longer-term programme of work, or business and organisational development. No stated match-funding requirement and no application fee. Applicants must hold a UK bank account in the same name as the application.
  • Esmee Fairbairn Foundation: Community-led Art and Creativity (rolling)
    https://esmeefairbairn.org.uk/our-aims/creative-confident-communities/community-led-art-creativity-grants/
    Esmee Fairbairn Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 30,000 minimum, no maximum. Funds core costs or project costs including staff salaries and overheads; unrestricted funding available to charities. No co-financing requirement stated. No application fee.
  • Paul Hamlyn Foundation: Arts-based Learning Fund (rolling)
    https://www.phf.org.uk/funding/arts-based-learning-fund
    Paul Hamlyn Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 30,000 to 300,000 total, capped at GBP 100,000 per year. Covers project costs and associated core and overhead costs of arts-education partnership work. No stated co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Hypha Studios: Speculative Exhibition Proposals (rolling)
    https://hyphastudios.com/apply-now-speculative-exhibition-proposals/
    Hypha Studios · deadline Rolling / undated · Free gallery/exhibition space in vacant high-street properties when scheduling gaps open; proposals are kept on file. Free to apply.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bring-film-wider-audience/bfi-national-lottery-audience-projects-fund

    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bfi-national-lottery-screen-heritage-fund-project-resilience-skills-funding

item.title: 4 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Visual Arts Scotland x Bothy Project: Sweeney's Bothy Residency 2026 (Isle of Eigg)
    https://www.visualartsscotland.org/opportunity/bothy-project-residency-2026/
    Visual Arts Scotland (VAS), in partnership with Bothy Project · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · GBP 720 artist fee, plus reasonable travel up to GBP 250 and accommodation costs included. No application fee.
  • Summerhall Arts Studio: Live Performance Development Residency 2026
    https://www.summerhallarts.co.uk/2026/06/summerhall-arts-studio/
    Summerhall Arts · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · Up to GBP 3,100 project budget (agreed between the Lead Artist and Summerhall Arts), plus five days in a dedicated space, technical support and access to simple lighting/sound/AV, creative/producing/technical guidance, and an informal end-of-week sharing. No application fee.
  • Gasworks Residency 2027: Artists Based in the Caribbean
    https://www.gasworks.org.uk/opportunities/residency-open-call-for-artists-based-in-the-caribbean-2027
    Gasworks (London), supported by Suzanne McFayden + The Nelumbo Collection · deadline Closed 29 Jun 2026 · Fully funded 11-week residency: 24/7 private studio at Gasworks, single-room accommodation in Gasworks Residency House, economy return flights + taxi transfers from home country (1 cabin + 1 hold bag), all visa costs and visa-application support, weekly stipend of GBP 175, materials budget up to GBP 800, prepaid TFL Zones 1+2 travel card, studio visits, Open Studio event on Saturday 13 March 2027, dedicated residency page on the Gasworks website with short video interview, networking + at least two individual studio visits, plus admin/pastoral/curatorial support. No application fee.
  • ESRC Digital Good Network: Artwork Commission (Expressions of Interest)
    https://digitalgood.net/artwork_commission_eoi/
    ESRC Digital Good Network · deadline Closed 01 Jul 2026 · Up to GBP 40,000 for the final commission, inclusive of VAT (capped at GBP 33,333 for artists based outside the UK due to reverse-charge VAT). Up to five shortlisted teams each receive GBP 1,000 to develop a proposal. No application fee.

    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/dycp
